# Hawk Stars NGO

> Associação HawkStars is a Portuguese non-profit organisation (NGO) based in Pinhel, Portugal, focused on cultural development, humanitarian action, youth mobility, and European cooperation through Erasmus+ and other EU-funded programmes.

## Quick Facts

- Founded: Evolved from Euro Hawk into Hawk Stars NGO
- Location: Pinhel, Guarda district, Portugal
- Type: Cultural and humanitarian non-profit association
- Languages: Portuguese (primary), English
- Website: https://hawkstars.org
- Contact: geral@hawkstars.org

## What We Do

Hawk Stars operates across four main pillars: international youth mobility through Erasmus+ and the European Solidarity Corps; local community development and cultural events in the Pinhel region; humanitarian aid operations (including aid to Ukraine); and the Global Village Project — an ambitious initiative to build an International Training Center in Pinhel.

## Key Programmes

- Erasmus+ Key Action 1: Youth exchanges, student mobility, traineeships, volunteer placements
- Erasmus+ Key Action 2: Cooperation partnerships with European organisations
- European Solidarity Corps: Long-term volunteering placements for 18–30 year olds
- Global Village Project: International Training Center development in Pinhel
